WITH RECURSIVE included_parts(sub_part, part, quantity) AS (
    SELECT sub_part, part, quantity FROM parts WHERE part = 'our_product'
  UNION ALL
    SELECT p.sub_part, p.part, p.quantity * pr.quantity
    FROM included_parts pr, parts p
    WHERE p.part = pr.sub_part
)
SELECT sub_part, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity
FROM included_parts

cases.source:
create or replace function public.do_stuff()
  returns trigger
  language plpgsql
as $function$
begin

  -- comment!
  with knn as (
    select
      h.alpha,
      -- TODO factor in distance
      avg(e.beta) as e_beta
    from htable h
    cross join lateral (
      select
        id,
        gamma,
        delta,
        centroid
      from ftable
      limit 3
    ) as e
    group by h.alpha
  )
  update htable set epsilon = epsilon + e_beta
  from knn
  where knn.alpha = htable.alpha;

  return new;

end;
$function$

cases.title: Merge into conditional upsert

USING monthly_accounts_update s

              VALUES(s.customer, s.purchases, s.address)
